steps.title: Short Steps
steps.explanation: To solve this problem using Newton's Law of Cooling, we start with the differential equation that describes the cooling process: \[ \frac{dT}{dt} = -k(T - T_a) \] where \( T \) is the temperature of the metal part at time \( t \), \( T_a \) is the ambient temperature (22°C), and \( k \) is the cooling constant.
